messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] installing packages from github
parts:
Ajay,

So I understand correctly, are you trying to install this package from your application code (ui.R or server.R)? If that is the case, you do not need to do that. In fact it is not allowed. 

ShinyApps will automatically detect which packages your application depends on, and installs those packages automatically on the server when you call deployApp().

-Andy


On Wed, Feb 26, 2014 at 8:31 PM, Ajay Pillarisetti <ajaypill...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi there -

I've got a package on github I'm trying to install. I get the following error:

Error: ERROR: no permission to install to directory '/usr/local/lib/R/site-library' Error: Command failed (1) Execution halted

Any thoughts? The package is a tweaked version of shiny-incubator (added some popovers to the little buttons in matrix input).

Thanks!

Ajay

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] installing packages from github
parts:
If you use a relatively recent version of devtools on your local machine to install packages from github, then yes, that should just work "automatically" with shinyapps.

could you please help or refer to any helpful link?
good day.
